section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1995
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1995 N.C.R.B.(M.H.A.) 2.7.4 The sex-wise breakup & details of percentage distribution of the Means adopted in various States, UTs & Cities are given in Appendix VIII. Fire/Self immolation was widely adopted by women in ending their lives as compared to men. In all 6836 females committed suicides through this means as against 3088 males. In all the 25 States & 7 UTs more females chose to commit suicides through this means. The male-female ratio adopting this means for suicide in the All-India was 31:67.
